checks.name: Four requests and bounded response budget

scope: Transport difference only; old ZIP parser retained. Seven mock cases, including stored/deflate success, malformed range/source/status and bounded overlong body. Curl command ignores curlrc, forces retry zero and redirect zero, HTTPS only, 25s limit, max-filesize length+1. Unlike urllib header-first logic, curl may store a bounded body before rejecting bad status/identity; this remains within declared body budget. Actual curl version 8.7.1 SecureTransport read locally. Streaming max-filesize behavior relies on installed curl implementation/manual, not a network test. Historical pre-curl requests reported as 24+10+7=41; no claim42 completed.
